title: dryopteris mongolica
intro: Dryopteris mongolica, commonly known as Mongolian wood fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris mongolica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
